description: Multi-step tasks over 3–5 nights. They pause on absence and never fail from it. Phase 4 content.

jobs.title: The Bell Under the Ash
jobs.reward: A Sight token and a named landmark.
jobs.opening: Somebody has heard a bell where no belfry stands.

jobs.title: Henrik's Debt
jobs.reward: A Market token and Henrik as patron.
jobs.opening: Henrik owes a man who does not forgive. He would rather owe you.

jobs.title: The Vanished Watch
jobs.opening: Six men of the Watch went into the Poor Quarter. Their lantern came back.
